capabilities: Intercept console.*() output and write it to a vault file
Log uncaught exceptions, including async and promise errors
Format logs as NDJSON, a Markdown table, or Markdown code blocks
Name log files after the device via the Sync plugin's device name
Filter NDJSON logs with tools like jq
extras: README warns to use at your own risk and always back up data; logs only output produced after the plugin is enabled; when proxying, all console output appears as coming from plugin:logstravaganza; author promotes his Actions for Obsidian app.
motivation: Lets plugin authors ask their users to install the plugin and send back the resulting log file when reporting bugs.
problem: Obsidian gives no way to capture console output and crashes from a running vault, making it hard for plugin developers to collect error logs from users.

relations.evidence: DEVICE-NAME is a placeholder for the actual device name as returned by the core Sync plugin

summary: Developer debugging utility that proxies console.*() calls and uncaught exceptions into a log note inside the vault.
